ENGAGEMENT LETTER
To the board of Harbour & Pine Joinery Ltd

We are pleased to confirm our appointment as auditors for the year ending 30 June 2026. Our audit will be
conducted with the aim of expressing an opinion on whether the financial statements give a true and fair view.

Responsibilities. The directors are responsible for preparing the financial statements and for such internal
control as they determine is necessary, including the prevention and detection of fraud. We will report to you
any significant deficiencies in internal control that we identify.

Fees. Our fee is based on the time required, estimated at $18,700 for this year.

Please sign and return the attached copy to confirm your agreement.
